scope: Pre-E-010 E-009 local, test, staging-like and fault Compose evidence

T-COMPOSE-STATIC-001.selector: bounded topology and known-fail static mutations
assertions: images, profiles, root filesystem, users, ports, networks and mounts are fail-closed
API, Admin, Worker and Migration secret/network allowlists remain distinct

T-COMPOSE-RUNTIME-001.selector: real Docker cold start, health, egress and shutdown
assertions: clean test topology reaches healthy with synthetic secrets and role-scoped database logins
ordinary services cannot reach arbitrary internet, metadata, Docker socket or another profile network

T-COMPOSE-FAULT-001.selector: deterministic PostgreSQL, Redis, provider, network, clock and telemetry faults
assertions: dependency loss removes readiness/heartbeat and recovery restores it
Redis restore mode repeats bounded rebuild until eligible PostgreSQL backlog is empty

T-COMPOSE-IMAGE-001.selector: fixed base image, clean final stages and runtime image inventory scan
assertions: Node 24.18.0 base image is fixed by digest
all four application images reject repository source, docs, tests, Prompt, fixture, secret-file and inline-secret paths

T-COMPOSE-PROFILE-001.selector: worker capability fingerprint, heartbeat and bounded rebuild
assertions: profile, database role, egress and fingerprint mismatch fails closed
heartbeat contains only status metadata and Redis rebuild is capped at twenty bounded passes

T-COMPOSE-API-001.selector: API role readiness and detail-free health
assertions: API database role mismatch reports only REQUIRED_DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE
database URL is read from a secret file and disconnected after each readiness probe

T-COMPOSE-ADMIN-001.selector: Compose internal Admin API origin boundary
assertions: http://api is allowed only by the explicit non-production Compose flag
production remains disabled without trusted identity configuration and adapter
